mapper.insert: INSERT INTO push_subscription (member_id, endpoint, p256dh, auth) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{endpoint}, #{p256dh}, #{auth}) ON CONFLICT (endpoint) DO UPDATE SET member_id = EXCLUDED.member_id, p256dh = EXCLUDED.p256dh, auth = EXCLUDED.auth
mapper.select: SELECT id, member_id as memberId, endpoint, p256dh, auth, created_at as createdAt FROM push_subscription
